Question
========
How can relative convergence and absolute divergence occur at the same time?

Answerlist
----------
* Small percentage gains on high incomes are worth more in money than large percentage gains on low incomes
* Because the data for the two views come from different years
* Because absolute measures ignore the rich
* They cannot occur at the same time

Solution
========
A 10% gain on 1,000 dollars is 100 dollars; on 1,000,000 dollars it is 100,000. Ratios can converge while dollar gaps widen.

* False
